name: luci-theme-md3e
description: Material Design 3 Expressive-inspired OpenWrt LuCI theme built with Vite and TailwindCSS

scripts.build: npm run assemble && node scripts/clean.js && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts scripts/*.js src/shared/*.js docs/*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts scripts/*.js src/shared/*.js docs/*.md
